subject: AWS Offer page review: SKU territory mapping, usage tiers & partner enablement
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Santos <marco.santos@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Apr 2028 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Offer page review: SKU territory mapping, usage tiers & partner enablement

Team — looping you in on ACME's final pass for our marketplace offer page. They want the SKU mapping and usage tiers to align with their internal territories for procurement and co-sell optics. Key asks from Acme (from Marco on the call):

- Clear SKU names for trial vs. metered usage; procurement needs a single SKU per trial tier.
- Bulletized usage examples per SKU (so field knows which SKU to demo).
- Evidence blurb for data residency + audit logs for enterprise buyers (short, link to binder).
- A co-sell one-pager they can share with their GTM partner team (one-page PDF).

Attached: sku_mapping_v3.xlsx (workbook with proposed SKU names), co-sell-one-pager.pdf (draft).

Can you each review the SKU names + the usage examples column and flag any legal/billing issues? Specific asks: 
- @Kimberly: check SKU naming/presentation and procurement language for private offers.
- @Jonas: confirm the entitlement logic (region mapping + GovCloud/backfill notes).
- @Aditya: quick field-facing bullets for the demo playbook.

Goal: finalize copy and SKU labels by EOD Thu so ACME can submit their internal request on Friday.

Thanks —
Olga
Olga Petrov
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Santos <marco.santos@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Apr 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Offer page review: SKU territory mapping, usage tiers & partner enablement

Thanks, Olga — quick pass below. I left a couple of inline notes in the attached SKU workbook but called out the high-level changes here: 

1) SKU naming: keep it short and procurement-friendly. Prefer pattern: "Redwood-Start-<vCPU>-Trial" for trial SKUs and "Redwood-Metered-<tier>-mo" for metered subscriptions. Avoid long descriptions in SKU strings since marketplace search truncates.

2) Usage examples: move the long-form paragraph into a three-bullet examples column. Field wants punchy callouts (e.g., "Embed summarization into CRM — 50k tokens/day typical demo").

3) PrivateOffer / procurement note: add a single line under each SKU: "Supports Private Offers (contact procurement@redwood.ai)" — procurement will want a concrete contact.

4) Evidence blurb: suggest this short paragraph for the product page: "Data processed per customer account is retained only for the duration required to serve requests. Audit logs and exportable usage traces are available upon request for enterprise contracts; SOC 2 Type II evidence packaged here: <link>." Keep it one sentence with a link to the evidence binder.

I've attached a redlined copy of sku_mapping_v3.xlsx with cell comments. Also uploaded a copy to the Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cSKUMapping

If you want, I can also draft the one-liner SKU footnote that the legal team prefers for listings (short, non-technical).

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Product Marketing | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Santos <marco.santos@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Apr 2028 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Offer page review: SKU territory mapping, usage tiers & partner enablement

Quick technical alignment from my side — flagged in entitlement_matrix.csv (attached). Highlights: 

- GovCloud / restricted-region handling: trial SKUs should redirect to a "BYO model" note for GovCloud customers (we can't ship AMIs there without additional customer paperwork). I added a footnote cell for that SKU.
- Region mapping: the "us-west-2" region will be the default for metered SKUs; add a fallback to eu-west-1 for EU customers to avoid latency spikes.
- Metering granularity: recommend per-token metering for metered SKUs with a monthly commit tier (Tier 1: <1M tokens/mo; Tier 2: 1M–10M; Tier 3: 10M+). The marketplace listing should show examples rather than raw limits.

Attaching: entitlement_matrix.csv (CSV), small excerpt pasted below for quick review.

--- excerpt ---
SKU,RegionFallback,GovCloudNote,Metering
Redwood-Metered-T1,us-west-2;eu-west-1,NotSupportedWithoutGovPaperwork,Per-token (examples provided)
Redwood-Start-2vcpu-Trial,us-west-2,Trial not available in GovCloud,Fixed 30-day trial
--- end excerpt ---

I'll sync with legal on the GovCloud line this afternoon — that language needs to be explicit so ACME's procurement doesn't get surprised.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Technical Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

From: Marco Santos <marco.santos@acme-analytics.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Apr 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Offer page review: SKU territory mapping, usage tiers & partner enablement

Olga / team — this is super helpful, thanks for the quick turnaround. A few next steps from ACME side: 

- Procurement asked for the short SKU list (final) and the private offer contact to raise an internal PO. Kimberly's "contact procurement@redwood.ai" line is perfect.
- For GovCloud customers we'll mark those accounts for an "onboarding exception" and route to our security team; can you confirm if Redwood's onboarding requires a specific questionnaire? If so, please share the form link.
- The co-sell one-pager looks good; we'll push it to our GTM partners next week and loop in our channel lead if we need tweaks.

I'll consolidate and send ACME's internal request by Monday morning. Please expect a procurement contact (procurement@acme-analytics.com) to ping your team for a Private Offer.

Thanks —
Marco Santos
Head of Cloud Platform Partnerships | Acme Analytics
